title: Plabic Newton–Okounkov Bodies and FFLV Polytopes
statement: For the distinguished non-mirror plabic graph $G_0$ associated with $\operatorname{Gr}_{k,n}(\mathbb C)$, is $\operatorname{NO}_{G_0}^r$ unimodularly equivalent to $\operatorname{FFLV}(r\varpi_k)$? This is known for $\operatorname{Gr}_{3,6}$.
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Mini-Workshop: PBW Structures in Representation Theory (2016), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2016/13, pp. 615--651](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2016/13)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** partially solved

**Assessment.** The Newton--Okounkov/FFLV identification is proved for the mirror or dual rectangle graph and for Gr(3,6), while the stated conjecture for the original graph G0 in all Gr(k,n) remains unresolved.
